records.statement: Current XRP ecosystem data contain material attribution and measurement gaps: Morpho cbXRP market UI utilization and oracle-secured-value fields do not reconcile or have clear scope; Coinbase Borrow does not disclose its share of permissionless Morpho positions; Coinbase cbXRP reserve addresses may overlap exchange-wallet aggregates; Alpha and Liqwall open interest differs by about 2.14x; XRP Insights exchange balances include cold storage and are not tradable float; RWA registry value is not transferable capital; USDC/RLUSD supply and x402 payment counts do not prove XRP purchases; SourceTag is a merchant endpoint rather than agent identity; SBI announcements and MOUs do not establish deployed capital; the Kamilah channel identity is likely but not fully authenticated.
